end.summary:
Practised identifying standing, sleeping and slanting straight lines.
Om used body position and familiar objects such as a table, slide and flagpole to describe line directions.
They made 6 attempts and answered 4 without help.
They later stated that slanting lines are straight but go in a tilted direction; teach-back was not passed.
The final left-position response was uncertain.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the three line directions using examples from everyday objects. Om explained standing lines as going straight up and later clarified that a slanting line does not bend; it goes straight in a tilted direction. There was an earlier mix-up between sleeping and slanting lines, and this was partly corrected later in the lesson (correctAfterLastSeen: true). At home, ask Om to draw one standing, one sleeping and one slanting line, then describe each direction aloud.
